title: Wind Turbine
guideExplore: Raise wind speed — blades spin faster and electrical power rises.
guideBreezy: Gentle breeze — blades turn slowly; power is low.
guideGale: Strong wind — high RPM and large electrical output.
conditionsHint: Wind turns the blades (mechanical energy), and a generator converts that into electricity.
quizCorrect: Wind energy → mechanical rotation → electrical energy
learnMore: Below cut-in speed (~3 m/s) there is no useful power. Above that, power rises steeply with wind speed.
